plan.same_process: One worker process, three original-state calls per case; each call receives a detached copy; outgoing state is never fed into another repeat.
plan.fresh_process: Four separate new Python interpreters, one original-state call per case.
plan.primary_comparison: Complete analysis_result, complete relationship_graph and supplied_reference. Strict equality includes execution metadata. Also report an evidence comparison excluding only /analysis_result/generated_at and /relationship_graph/runtime_seconds. Full unmodified responses and all their differences are preserved.
plan.full_response_comparison: No fields excluded; recursive exact field-level comparison.
plan.hash_semantics: SHA-256 of compact sorted-key JSON for result evidence; additional unsorted ordered-input JSON hash and exact row-key order verification.

environment.runtime: isolated temporary local runtime per worker, as in original protocol; no analytical overrides

limitations: Exactly four selected original-state calls were tested; no full chronological rerun or broader sensitivity study.
Execution timestamp and graph runtime are excluded only in the explicitly labeled evidence comparison; strict complete-output comparisons retain them.
Matching outputs establish reproducibility under the recorded environment and canonical ordering, not correctness of plant-event interpretation.
Existing reports and headline claims were not edited.

post_execution_component_diagnostics.scope: Read-only comparisons of preserved results after the declared test. Does not alter primary exclusions, match counts or raw outputs.
